name: MuSR
description: Multistep Soft Reasoning tests models on extended, multi-step soft reasoning tasks that require tracking multiple entities, relationships, and logical chains across narratives. Tasks include murder mystery solving, team allocation, and object placement tracking. Designed to evaluate reasoning that requires maintaining and updating coherent world models across long inference chains.
reputation: Included in HuggingFace Open LLM Leaderboard v2 as one of six core benchmarks; published by UT Austin researchers; distinguishes models that can maintain coherent multi-step reasoning chains
notes: One of six benchmarks on the HuggingFace Open LLM Leaderboard v2 alongside IFEval, BBH, MATH, GPQA, and MMLU-Pro. Tasks are algorithmically generated ensuring no contamination. Tests 'soft' reasoning (commonsense inference chains) rather than formal logic. Published in 2023.
